QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_14

question.text: Which of the following is a Regulation 27 record-keeping requirement for a Cat III AIF?

answer.text: All material contracts of investee companies
Effective rate of return for every investor

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Regulation 27 requires the Manager/Sponsor to maintain records of (a) assets under the scheme, (b) valuation policies and practices, (c) investment strategies, (d) particulars of investors and their contribution, (e) rationale for investments made. Records are kept for 5 years after winding up. **The Trap:** Option A (investee-company contracts) is NOT in the Reg 27 list. Options C and D are distractor topics. The verbatim wording of Reg 27 is tested. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C / XIX-D test the same Reg 27 record list. Sample Q1 in the PDF uses this exact framing. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Archive the valuation-policy versioning with git-like commit history (signed by valuer + compliance). Side-pocket creation days, HWM resets, and independent-valuer appointments all leave an evidence trail — Regulation 27 + 5-year retention means your records outlive most employees.
